conventions.px: pivot in atlas pixels, relative to the frame rect top-left (x, y). Draw at (dx - px, dy - py). The rect is the content only; the gutter lies outside it.

anchors.feet: ground contact: bottom centre of the lowest 3% of the figure
anchors.body: centre of the figure box (dead, down, flying)

conventions.scale: atlas px per source px. One scale per entity: every frame of a character uses the scale that makes its idle frame heightPx tall.
conventions.facing: side views face right; mirror at runtime for left. The hero front view faces the camera (down), back away (up).
conventions.encoding: png8 = 256-colour palette PNG, chosen when colourError.over8 <= 0.12; png32 = RGBA. colourError is measured on alpha >= 128 pixels: over8 is the share off by more than 8 levels in any channel.
